title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative compressible perfect-gas formulation is stated and implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured mixed-cell geometry and boundary-family handling are present.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual assembly and global residual reductions are explicit in solver.cpp.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux is the documented and implemented approximate Riemann flux; no entropy fix is claimed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip wall, and no-slip adiabatic wall paths are present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares reconstruction with production Venkatakrishnan limiting is documented and implemented.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Positivity clamping and CFL-halving fallback are documented and present.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Gradient-based Newtonian/Fourier path and tangential viscous-force split are present; no independent rerun.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Matrix-free LU-SGS/local-CFL steady march implemented and contestant outputs converge.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 outer physical loop and actual inner statistics present; Re200 reaches t=300 but fails the required vortex-shedding behavior.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor point-to-point halo exchange with global reductions are directly evidenced; no rank-count comparison.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
